source.method: OpenStreetMap as drawn (Overpass, the app's own query, Oct 4 2026), filtered to this club: only the hole ways tagged golf:course:name=18 Hole (OSM also has the club's 9-hole par-3 course and Country Club of the South next door, whose hole numbers collide with these). A green, tee, bunker, fairway or hazard is kept when its nearest hole line is one of the 18 and it is within 150 m; woods and water within 100 m. Multipolygons with holes (inner rings) are left out. Pars are the card's (Black tee); OSM's agree on all 18.
source.caveat: Not traced by hand: as accurate as OSM. Hole lines measured 2–9% shorter than the Black-tee card yardages, as OSM lines usually are.
